description.sv: Skateboard GB:s juniortävling "Survival of the Sickest" i Folkestone, på F51 Skatepark — park/bowl-tävling för ungdomar (Under 12 och Under 16), fokus på kul och utveckling snarare än elitnivå.
description.en: Skateboard GB's junior competition series "Survival of the Sickest" comes to F51 Skatepark, Folkestone — a park/bowl event for youngsters (Under 12 and Under 16 age categories), focused on fun and progression rather than elite competition.

source.note: Fetched directly from Skateboard GB's official event page. Page is tagged 'Junior Event' — level set to "amateur" as a best guess since I don't know your schema's exact enum values for junior/youth events; verify against src/lib/schema.ts. Coordinates are Folkestone town-level approximations, not the exact venue pin — the venue name/address should be enough for the Google Maps text-search fallback regardless.
